Choosing a material¶

Use one of the exact registry names below as P.S.law (or on each entry in P.S when it is a list). Every material also needs the particle geometry, initial density, and represented area described in Create a simulation. All tensor components use SI units and tension-positive Cauchy stress.

Name

Required model parameters

Meaning / scope

rigid

Optional initial_v

Prescribed motion with no deformable stress evolution.

elastic

K, G

Compressible neo-Hookean elasticity, with bulk/shear moduli in Pa. Legacy mode retains incremental isotropic elasticity.

viscous

K, mu_s, mu_v

Newtonian fluid; viscosities in Pa s. The zero-yield Bingham limit gives the same stress law.

von_mises

K, G, yield_stress (or k)

Perfect J2 return map, yield stress in Pa. sqrt(3)*k is an alternative yield stress. s only controls the legacy H² law.

pouliquen

K, rho_s, mu_0, delta_mu, I_0, eta_max

Local granular friction law with a viscosity cap. Uses engineering shear rate and current physical density. Also supply mu_1 and packing for the example’s steady-flow initialisation; mu_1=mu_0+delta_mu.

bingham

K, mu_s, mu_0, tau_0; optional mu_v

Bi-viscosity approximation to Bingham flow. Small creep below yield is permitted; gamma_c is derived and need not be supplied.

dp

K, G, mu, beta

Cohesionless Drucker-Prager plasticity. mu is the q/p yield slope, not a friction angle; beta controls dilation.

dp_rate

As dp, plus t_star

Linear Perzyna regularisation. t_star is the shear-overstress relaxation time in seconds for zero dilation; zero gives the dp update.

linear_mu

K, rho_s, mu_0, b, eta_max

Dense flowing mu(I)=mu_0+b I law with a viscosity cap. b=0 gives constant friction. It is not a dilute/collisional granular model.

K and G are Pa; rho_s is solid-grain density in kg/m³; grain diameters P.G.s are metres; eta_max and viscosities are Pa s; tau_0 is Pa. Friction coefficients, I_0, b, and beta are dimensionless. For flow laws, phi @ P.G.s supplies the local mean diameter where used.

The constitutive reference gives equations, allowed parameter ranges, sign conventions, integration, and analytical checks. See Numerical methods for deformation, transfer, and diagnostic conventions. These checks are not experimental validation. Select and calibrate a law for the intended regime rather than switching names and retaining unrelated parameters.

Initialisation can require additional parameters: confined stress and the legacy non-zero/temperature modes may use elastic moduli; steady-flow options are only implemented for particular laws. Start with a working input using the same initialisation and inspect its setup before changing it. Algebraic Bingham and linear-friction fluids do not need an elastic shear modulus.

elastic_time, ken_kamrin, and ken_simple are retired with explicit reasons in the constitutive reference. Their archived source is not imported. viscous_size and the separate legacy P.F compressible-fluid path remain unimplemented.

poly-mpm

2D material point method with grain-size segregation
